summary: Full v3 backend + frontend regression for TransferMemory multi-view app. 34/34 backend pytest tests pass (12 pre-existing + 22 new for coaches/clubs/filters/recent/radar/pipeline/tasks). All new frontend flows verified end-to-end including sidebar nav, role & club filters, career/timeline tabs, Radar Feed with LIVE Claude Simulate Scan, Working Pipeline stage moves (PATCH), Verification Checklist task toggle, dismiss/investigate flows, EN<->IT toggle, logout toast, global search auto-switch, Log Rumor dialog. Emergent LLM key confirmed LIVE (radar/scan produced fresh AI alert). The iteration_1 issue about consistency-widget verdict disappearing after Save has been fixed in App.js via the preserveResult ref pattern.
action_items: None required — all v3 features working. Only cosmetic dev-only console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' comes from the Emergent visual-editor wrapper injecting <span> inside <option> in NewRumorDialog selects (same as iteration_1, safe to ignore, not present in production build).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: repeated investigate on the same player (already-created pipeline) is idempotent via find_one player_name check — good. However, repeated radar/scan will accumulate alerts indefinitely (no cap); consider a rolling window or archive strategy for production.
server.py:_extract_json uses greedy regex; works but assumes single top-level JSON object. Consider using json.loads first, fall back to regex only on parse failure, for slightly better fidelity.

PipelineBoard.jsx duplicates STAGES from backend seed_data.PIPELINE_STAGES — DRY violation. Consider fetching stages from an /api/pipeline/stages endpoint or exposing PIPELINE_STAGES through /api/config.

App.js is now the orchestration hub with 10+ pieces of state and 8 handlers (196 lines). Approaching the file-size threshold; could be split into a useTransferMemory hook or context provider to improve maintainability.

Radar alerts filter shows/hides Dismissed on the client (RadarFeed.jsx line 19). If alerts list grows large, consider passing status=New,Investigating,Verified as a query param instead to reduce payload.
No pagination on /api/pipeline, /api/tasks, /api/radar/alerts — .to_list(500) is fine at seed scale but should be paginated for production if long-running scans accumulate.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all sidebar nav, profile detail, filters, search, radar feed, pipeline moves, task toggle, LIVE Claude scan, language toggle, logout toast, log rumor dialog verified)

test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds v3 (12 profiles: 8 players + 4 coaches, 9 sources, 28 rumors, 5 global_alerts, 4 pipeline items, 5 verification tasks) on first startup via SEED_VERSION=3 gating. Note: previous test runs have added rows: at test time pipeline had 6 cards, tasks had 11, alerts up to 8 — this is expected behavior since seed is idempotent and tests / user actions accumulate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v3 features work. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_transfer_memory.py and test_v3_features.py. AI radar scan is LIVE (Claude Sonnet 4.6). If the alert/pipeline/task counts grow between runs it's expected — investigate creates pipeline + 3 tasks per new alert. iteration_1's known bug (consistency verdict disappearing after Save) has been fixed via App.js preserveResult ref pattern; confirmed via code review.
